name: What factors influence the cost of kitchen cabinet removal?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of kitchen cabinet removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing kitchen cabinets generally costs less than replacing or refacing them, though total project costs vary based on kitchen footprint and disposal needs. Preserving cabinets intact requires careful manual unscrewing, which involves more labor hours than fast demolition meant purely for scrap. Additional cost variables include whether heavy stone countertops require specialized lifting, hauling fees for disposal, and the need for minor drywall patching before new installations begin.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removal costs depend on kitchen layout size, whether cabinets are salvaged or trashed, countertop detachment complexity, and debris hauling fees.
